basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 8.' and it opens 'Vers. 8. Dixitque Cain ad Abel fratrem suum: | Sed hoc, quod a Deo audierat: superfluum'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 8. Dixitque Cain ad Abel fratrem suum: | Sed hoc, quod a Deo audierat: superfluum enim est. Egrediamur foras. Neque enim adhuc domus vel templum erat ubi Deo sacrificium offerretur. Et consurrexit Cain adversus fratrem suum, et interfecit eum. Retro, ut ferunt, pastorali virga. Allegorice in scelere Cain malitia Judaeorum designatur. Cain occidit minorem fratrem suum Abel, et Judaei Christum caput minoris populi, id est gentilis, sicut ipse per Psalmistam dixerat Patri: Constitues me in caput gentium (Psal. XVII, 44).
